purpose: Create one deterministic, uncertainty-bearing synthetic physical-geography state at R6 t0=210 Ma; no trajectory or later-domain state.

reference_only: local HYBRID-1 v0.1 source and 210 Ma output
forbidden_as_numeric_initializer: HYBRID-1 hard-coded polygon geometry or seed 917231

provider_suitability.reason: Repository archaeology found no canonical physical-world generator or validated specialist that supplies this exact authorial synthetic t0 state. A1 is reference data, not an engine or initializer; the v0.1 prototype is not a governed physical process model.

algorithm_outline: Construct spherical plate domains by assigning each unit-sphere cell center to the nearest deterministically seeded plate nucleus (maximum dot product/spherical Voronoi partition), with 12–18 plates and explicit longitude-wrap/pole-safe adjacency.

Place 4–8 continental cratonic blocks under a deterministic clustered-supercontinent constraint; sutured block boundaries and any designed internal orogenic provinces are explicit categorical features.
Construct coastlines from bounded multiscale spherical fields at native 1-degree generation support; use no raster upsampling and suppress unsupported cell-scale speckle.

Solve the sea-level threshold against the specified land-area envelope and connected-supercontinent constraints; record the resulting threshold and diagnostics as authorial parameters, not a physical ocean-volume solution.

Generate land elevation from a versioned bounded hypsometric field conditioned on categorical province/boundary classes; use independent named random streams and emit uncertainty/provenance per field.
Require complete supported land elevation/topology suitable for a later drainage analysis; preserve plausible closed basins and do not blanket-fill depressions or materialize a drainage network.
Emit UNKNOWN plate velocities, ocean bathymetry, Deep, climate, hydrology, lithology, regolith, soil and all non-geography domains unless a separate authority is bound.
generation_method.numerical_claim: A designed initial condition only; not a forward tectonic simulation, geological reconstruction, or empirical 210 Ma Earth map.
generation_method.temporal_support: One INITIAL_STATE at exactly 210 Ma; no other time samples.

continuous.land_surface_elevation_m: finite in [0,8000] where supported; null/UNKNOWN elsewhere
continuous.ocean_bathymetry_m: UNKNOWN; no numeric values in v1

field_schema.prohibited_field_inference: A numeric value or categorical membership does not itself establish observational authority.

seed_and_determinism.child_derivation: SHA256(root_digest || 0x00 || generator_version || 0x00 || domain_stream_name); first 128 digest bits unsigned big-endian
requirements: Stable canonical serialization of configuration and stream identifiers
Repeat run with identical source/config/runtime/seed must yield byte-identical canonical payloads or a documented deterministic encoding proof

output_package.large_payload_policy: Keep arrays outside ordinary Git under the established external simulation-results root; register relative path, byte size, SHA256, schema, grid, time, field semantics and authority in the manifest.
expected_payloads: R6_INITIAL_PHYSICAL_GEOGRAPHY.npz or an equivalently typed chunked store
output_package.atomicity: Write to a unique temporary run directory; validate and hash completely before atomic promotion to immutable run identity. Never overwrite a prior materialization.

benchmark_requirements_before_freeze_of_: grid topology, dateline seam and pole adjacency fixtures
area-weighted statistics and exact cell area
elevation bounds, finite support and spatial spectrum sanity checks
peak RAM and wall-clock on target hardware
sensitivity to seed/config without changing frozen specification envelopes
